name: Rock Paper Scissors
tagline: Both throw at once. Rock breaks scissors, scissors cut paper, paper covers rock.
description: The old hand game, for two. Each player secretly chooses rock, paper or scissors; the throws are shown together once both are in. A draw is thrown again.

sections.markdown:
Rock Paper Scissors is settled in a single throw.

- **Throw.** Both players choose rock, paper or scissors **at the same time**. Your choice is kept from your opponent until they have chosen too, so neither of you can answer the other.
- **Who wins.** **Rock** breaks **scissors**, **scissors** cut **paper**, and **paper** covers **rock**.
- **A draw.** If both throw the same, the round is thrown again.
- **The end.** The first round that is not a draw decides the match.
